contents:
[package]
name = "vir-search"
version = "1.4.2"
edition = "2024"
rust-version = "1.85"
license = "MIT"
repository = "https://github.com/VirInvictus/vir-search"
authors = ["Brandon LaRocque"]
description = "Calibre-style search expression parser, AST, and relevance engine."
keywords = ["search", "parser", "query-language", "calibre", "ast"]
categories = ["parser-implementations", "text-processing"]

[dependencies]
regex = "1.10"
chrono = "0.4"
unicode-normalization = "0.1"

[source.vendored-sources]
directory = "cargo/vendor"

[source.crates-io]
replace-with = "vendored-sources"

[source."https://github.com/virinvictus/vir-gtk"]
git = "https://github.com/virinvictus/vir-gtk"
replace-with = "vendored-sources"

[source."https://github.com/virinvictus/vir-search"]
git = "https://github.com/virinvictus/vir-search"
replace-with = "vendored-sources"
